items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I had an uncle, Amos, he played music. That was before I was born.

ctx.x: About where George Lewis lives now, down in that section. Down in that section. Did your parents play any musical instruments?
I had an uncle, Amos, he played music. That was before I was born. Yes. What instrument did he play? He played bass horn. Bass. Amos Martin.
